OSS Integrity View

Zeo provides comprehensive open-source governance tooling. The OSS Integrity View monitors compliance, tracks dependency health, and maintains audit transparency across your entire project surface.

Governance Features

Dependency Visibility

Full dependency tree scanning with vulnerability detection, license compliance checking, and supply chain integrity verification.

API Surface Awareness

Automatic discovery and tracking of exposed API endpoints. Surface area changes are flagged in PR reviews.

Key Rotation Signaling

Proactive alerts when keys or tokens approach expiration. Rotation history is tracked in the audit ledger.

Audit Trace Transparency

Every governance check produces a signed evidence record. Audit trails are immutable and cryptographically verifiable.

Integrity Dashboard

The integrity dashboard shows license verification, contribution rules, and real-time compliance matrix status.
